title: Save settings
description: save/settings.yaml of the game pack: how many save slots there are (game/save, docs/architecture/save.md). When the game autosaves is the ruleset's save section.

manual_slots.description: Slots the player saves to from the save menu. The original had up to 15 per memory card.

autosave_slots.description: Ignored: from when autosaves had slots of their own. The autosave writes the playthrough's own slot.
